title: Crop card: a two-character word set so large the frame shows only part of it, one small label on a plate
use: A title word as texture: legible as shape, readable from the label.

ground.note: ground tone of the card: black, paper white or signal red (style groundTones)

relations: The label sits on a plate of the ground colour so the word never runs under it.

provenance.corpus: Nocturne Corridor (夜想回廊) experiment: our own original fictional anime set in the shinbo style pack's grammar, first pass and reviewed final
provenance.method: Geometry taken from the final round's HTML/CSS as fractions of W and H; text sizes and colours chosen so the final passed the browser check (contrast with text hidden, ink overlap, collage alpha, off-canvas). All copy is original.
measured: 回廊 1500px from x -260, top -300; label 34px on a 330x80 plate at 1500,900; the em-box check reported an overlap, the ink check (plate above the word) does not
